item.text: The current package only exposes random `Reseed`; it stores opaque `maphash.Seed` values, which cannot be reconstructed from a caller supplied string. I’m changing the per-ID seed to a string, mixing it into each hash under a stable package-level `maphash.Seed`, and protecting lazy initialization/reseeding with a mutex. This preserves the existing random reseed behavior while adding repeatable `SetSeed`.

Implemented per-ID deterministic seeding in [hasher.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher.go). The package and `Hasher` now expose `SetSeed`; setting the same seed again restores the same hash. Missing IDs are initialized automatically, and `Reseed` assigns a fresh random seed. Seed access is mutex protected.

`go test ./utils/hasher` passes.
